Currently, if a file is edited externally while the user has unsaved changes, and then the user undoes all their edits, the buffer remains stale and doesn't reflect the latest disk content. The solution should detect when a buffer transitions from dirty to clean and check if the file was modified externally during that dirty period.
functional_requirements: When a buffer transitions from dirty to clean (e.g., after an undo operation that removes all unsaved changes), check if the file's modification time changed while the buffer was dirty.
If the file's mtime changed during the dirty period and the file still exists on disk, emit a ReloadNeeded signal to trigger a reload.
Ensure this reload logic only fires for files that are present on disk (DiskState::Present) and doesn't cause double reloads by coordinating with existing file update tracking.

spec.description: Implement chronological sorting for threads in the sidebar based on their creation time. Currently threads appear in an unspecified order, but they should be displayed from newest to oldest to provide better context about conversation flow. This change should apply consistently across all thread displays in the sidebar interface.
functional_requirements: Sort threads in descending order by creation timestamp (newest first)
Apply the sorting consistently across all thread list views in the sidebar
Ensure the sorting logic works with existing thread filtering and search functionality
Maintain thread grouping and categorization while applying chronological ordering
Update any related UI components that display thread lists to use the new sorting
Preserve thread selection and navigation behavior after implementing the sorting change
